commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Real Madrid was in an offside position.
90+4' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
90+4' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+3' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
90+1' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) was probably a bit loose with his words to Jose Sanchez, who decides to show him a yellow.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Lucas Vazquez will be replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Rodrygo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
87' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
86' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid).
84' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Adama Boiro is replaced by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao).
83' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
83' Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
80' 2 - 1 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 2:1.
80' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Julen Agirrezabala has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
79' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) replacing Andoni Gorosabel.
79' The substitution has been made. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) has replaced Oihan Sancet.
78' 1 - 1 Goal 1:1! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
78' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Julen Agirrezabala easily deals with the threat.
78' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
77' A player from Ath Bilbao commits a rough challenge. Jose Sanchez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
75' A cross from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
74' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) for a tough tackle.
74' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise pass inside the box and fires the ball goalwards. His attempt is blocked by one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
73' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
72' A yellow card for a tackle by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid). Jose Sanchez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
71' Substitution. Fran Garcia walks off the pitch and Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
71' Here is a change. Aurelien Tchouameni is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
70' The foul by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Sanchez.
70' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
69' The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Julen Agirrezabala dives to the left side of the goal and brilliantly saves the penalty taken by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid)!
68' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
67' Today's referee Jose Sanchez rightly decides to book Julen Agirrezabala (Ath Bilbao) for his harsh tackle.
67' Julen Agirrezabala (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Real Madrid.
67' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He plants his header against the crossbar!
66' Jose Sanchez blows the whistle, Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Real Madrid.
65' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
64' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
63' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) replaces Benat Prados Diaz.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) will replace Alex Berenguer.
62' Julen Agirrezabala displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
60' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
60' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
59' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Julen Agirrezabala is equal to it and makes an easy save.
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is replacing Dani Ceballos.
57' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
53' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. The ball rebounds to Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
53' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
49' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Sanchez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
47' The attendance for today's match is 51364.
47' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Ath Bilbao are ruled offside.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Real Madrid.
43' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
43' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao).
40' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
40' Handball! A player from Ath Bilbao handled the ball.
38' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
37' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Jose Sanchez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
33' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

31' Thibaut Courtois doesn't have to worry about this one. Inaki Williams plays a pass into the feet of Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
29' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
29' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) works the corner short.

29' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner.
27' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
25' The linesman signals that Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
24' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
20' A player from Ath Bilbao takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid have a free kick from a promising distance.
18' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
16' The goal by Real Madrid won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
14' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Jose Sanchez wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
13' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
12' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
10' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
9' The Real Madrid players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
6' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
4' Half-chance! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) plays a pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois reacts well to snuff out the attack.
4' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
2' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball onto Alex Berenguer, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
1' The match has just started.
